aggregationControlled.method: Separate fresh Node processes, same saved production snapshot, --expose-gc --import tsx, no CPU profiler; two warmups omitted, twenty measurements per implementation. GC before each measured call; JSON hash outside elapsed aggregation interval.

rejectedAllocatorTuning.decision: Do not apply: reduced RSS with 2 arenas nearly doubled read latency; 8 arenas did not improve RSS.

verification.franchiseEquivalence: Exact deep equality on real snapshot: all, completed, September, empty interval, all 12 individual leagues

manual: RPL auto-pick a valid 15-player squad, save before release and restore after release
75 franchise groups, virtual group with 24 rows, September date filter
Light and dark mobile 390px: document scrollWidth 390px
browser.note: Browser navigation timings are observations; differing asset cache/viewport states are not used for the controlled server speed comparison.

limitations: Local HTTP uses a remote database over SSH, so those latencies are not compared with production loopback.
Pre-release RSS and post-restart RSS alone cannot establish a long-running leak improvement.

Full worker cycle processed all twelve leagues in a child; the read-only pre-change build probe covered one league three times. They establish lifecycle/retention behavior, not a directly comparable full-cycle timing.
